name: Connected world: route and segment contract
scope: Design-only adjacency, crossings and compatibility prototype. No application import, generated art, player save or game rule is changed.

coordinates.originRule: region origin = minimum col,row; zone origin = (col-minCol)*width,(row-minRow)*height
coordinates.portRule: One connection owns the shared [start,end) lateral span. Both reciprocal ports are derived from that record; all unlisted seam cells are blocked.

regions.name: Home valley
regions.role: Three short overlapping loops around home and the existing mission places.

regions.name: Nap hut
regions.role: Separate interior reached through the existing garden door.

regions.name: Cogsworth
regions.role: Compact working canal town; rail interchange, not an obligatory grind hub.

regions.name: Sunreach
regions.role: Proposed continuous rain-shadow basin: oasis, dry town, basalt pass, supported lava crossing and castle terminus. Replaces the west/lava layout only after a tested migration and matching art.

regions.name: Neon Harbour
regions.role: A deliberately separate bright city reached by the existing maglev, not a sharp climate seam in the home meadow.

regions.name: Halcyon
regions.role: Existing separate orbital destination; no walkable ground connection to the island.

regions.name: Lumen
regions.role: Existing shuttle destination kept off the terrestrial geographic plate.

zones.role: Existing mountain mission cabin; one northward spur, not a new unlock.
Quiet west loop and spring woodland.
Home and four existing exits; the quiet clearing is not a road junction full of props.
River and mill, with bank-side walking; water has a source and an outlet.
Existing train platform; joins the west loop without a new journey cost.
Existing library, shop and sparring ring; a legible square with a clear through-route.
Existing park mission and east-loop resting place.
Sea-level river outlet and working harbour.
New elevated coastal endpoint for the valley loop. The old coastal castle position migrates here; the inland castle is a different destination.
Existing hut interior; its threshold is a door, not a tile seam.
Existing train interchange and ring.
Existing canal district; supported bridge and quay, not land props on water.
Wet refuge at the dry basin's west edge; no timed access or care demand.
Existing dry town and train platform; mine-cart shortcut retained.
New scrub-to-ash transition and sheltered switchback; not an instantaneous sand/lava boundary.
New supported east-west crossing with solid abutments. North branch begins on the EAST abutment, never in the lava channel.
Relocated design castle at the end of one guarded approach. No second entrance from the springs and no false discovery carried from the former coastal castle.
Existing caldera identity; mine-cart landing and ring retained. Upstream vent scenery needs no new damage rule.
Existing hot springs identity. Continuous escarpment on its south edge keeps it separate from the castle below.
Existing city quay and court.
Existing region travel point for BOTH maglev and elevator; do not invent a different station contract.
Existing Halcyon arrival at the lift standing point; shuttle presentation does not introduce an additional journey rule.
Existing quiet lunar grove and ring.

transitIdentityContract.stopIds: Stable existing service IDs, independent of the proposed physical RegionId.
transitIdentityContract.physicalRegions: Walking, camera and save layout domains. Several service stops may occupy one physical region.
transitIdentityContract.integrationGap: Current travelRoute(fromRegion,toRegion) returns [] when the region IDs match, and travelPoints has one point per RegionId. It cannot directly represent both west and lava stops in sunreach. A stop-ID to physical-region/zone/point adapter and updated trip ownership are REQUIRED before live integration.
transitIdentityContract.prototypeOnly: The checker routes on serviceEndpoints, never on physicalRegion equality. No current runtime API or RegionId type is changed.

blockedAdjacencies.reason: Continuous basalt escarpment on castle north / springs south. No stairs, ramp, gate, door or crossing. Castle remains a one-approach terminus.

corridorRules.varyWidthByAbout: one-third within each approach; shared border span is exact
corridorRules.outsideListedSpans: blocked with continuous legible terrain framing
corridorRules.geometryProof: NOT PROVIDED: abstract connection and synthetic edge-mask checks do not prove generated terrain, bridge supports, door clearance, landmark sightlines or rendered seams.

syntheticMaskExample.default: Open interior with closed border cells except the declared ports. This proves the abstract crossing contract only.

lavaBridge.northBranch: Solid east abutment, x >= 224. The central lava column remains blocked north of the bridge.

lifecycle.prototype: The checker demonstrates generation-token cancellation and one-shot completion. This is NOT a claim that existing app/world.tsx or AtlasWalk implements this reducer.
lifecycle.selection: Show the existing destination card; do not start a mission or spend anything.
lifecycle.departure: Recheck current focus, foreground, awake state, battle, pending return and existing mission level rule at explicit action time.
lifecycle.newIntent: Increment generation; replace the previous walk or trip intent.
lifecycle.cancel: Increment generation on interruption, route departure or invalidated owner; ignore stale completion callbacks.
lifecycle.completion: Accept matching active generation exactly once, settle position once, and clear intent.
lifecycle.existingJourneyPolicy: Current Journey arrives at a leg when backgrounded; SKIP arrives at the final destination. Keep this existing policy unless Claude deliberately adapts it, with the same one-shot owner checks.
lifecycle.reducedMotion: Use the same selected endpoint, with still/finite presentation and no rule or reward differences.
lifecycle.homeArrival: Retain current yard/door arrival debounce; do not bounce immediately back through the arrival threshold.

migrationPrototype.discoveryRule: Map legacy coastal castle discovery to headland; retain original discovery separately in legacyDiscovery. Never mark the new inland castle visited merely because old castle was visited.
migrationPrototype.positionRule: Resolve old absolute coordinates using OLD minimum col,row; retain local x,y and move that local position to the proposed zone origin. Validate the actual new grid before any real save migration.
migrationPrototype.unsupportedInputRule: Return an explicit unresolved result without mutating or overwriting the original save. Unknown future layout versions are not interpreted.
